order_design: all 24 artifact permutations once per mode, seeded shuffle 20261026; each artifact occupies each run position exactly six times
inference_metrics: llama-bench prompt tokens/s (512-token prompt) and generation tokens/s (128 tokens); each single-repetition process is one sample
interval_method: paired per-permutation throughput ratios against source; mean plus/minus Student t 95% interval with df=23 (t*=2.069); descriptive, not a claim of generalization
